name: f9_source_frozen_grab_unseen_user_gate_v1
correction: Version 1 incorrectly described five 2048-sample windows. The existing GRABMyo protocol actually uses twenty 512-sample windows per 10240-sample native trial; corrected before quality fitting or target outcome analysis.
source: GRABMyo Day1 subjects 1-4, all native trials and twenty fixed 512-sample windows per trial
descriptive_final: GRABMyo Day1 unseen subjects 7-8; previously inspected in other studies
trial_gate: Reject a native trial when any of its twenty frozen windows has minimum-channel quality below 0.5

analysis: Read frozen F0v2 trial probabilities by exact native trial ID. Report per-phase and per-subject coverage, errors rejected, correct trials rejected, and per-gesture rejection. Do not refit the classifier or select a threshold using target outcomes.
decision: Diagnostic only. Do not promote the gate without acceptable validation coverage and measured physical-fault evidence.
